name: AMEEN MOHAMMED TP
tagline: ECE Student | Coding Enthusiast | Hardware-Software Integration
bio: I'm an Electronics and Communication Engineering student fascinated by both hardware and software aspects of technology. I enjoy programming, solving logical problems, exploring electronic systems, and understanding how software and hardware work together. I'm particularly interested in coding and experimenting with electronics, constantly learning and building things that challenge my engineering skills.

projects.title: Digital Fire Detection and Alarm System
projects.desc: An electronic fire detection system using temperature sensing, comparator logic, an D Flip-flop, and a 555 timer to provide a persistent visual and audible alarm.

projects.title: Arduino-Based Braille Keyboard
projects.desc: An assistive technology project designed to help visually impaired users interact with a keyboard through Braille input and audio feedback.
